column1: # XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense Partition Table for OTA (8MB Flash)
# App partitions (ota_0/ota_1) MUST start on a 0x10000 (64KB) boundary —
# ESP-IDF rejects unaligned app offsets ("Offset ... is not aligned to 0x10000").
#   coredump: 128KB (ELF core dump after a panic
# The partition table is written only by a USB/web-flasher flash
# OTA: a robot updated over the air keeps its old table
# that there is no core dump partition and carries on without dumps.
